headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
conceptNote: 黒いガラスの大きな動画画面に、半透明の赤いチャットを重ねる。放送機材のような質感と大きなタイポグラフィ。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE polished Chrome extension store listing promotional image, not a collage or variations. Landscape exact 11:7 aspect ratio, target 1760 x 1120 pixels, edge-to-edge.

Subject: an elegant abstract diagram communicating video fullscreen with live chat staying INSIDE the same video, built from a single large 16:9 screen, a play triangle, four fullscreen-corner marks, and one translucent chat pane contained entirely inside the right side of the screen. The chat pane has only three refined horizontal marks and a tiny abstract input/send line; no invented names, messages, numbers, or dashboard UI.

Art direction: premium broadcast design, charcoal smoked-glass screen with subtly bevelled graphite edge, a translucent deep-red chat pane with very restrained inner rim light. Deep matte black background. Designed by a meticulous editorial brand designer: generous negative space, precise alignment, soft restrained depth and realistic material contrast, confident typography. Avoid a floating sci-fi gadget, neon gaming poster, exaggerated 3D, generic AI glow or glossy blobs. Main screen lies nearly front-facing so the meaning remains immediate. Red, off-white and black only.

Typography layout: left upper area has three separate text lines, exactly these words each once:
"YouTube"
"Fullscreen"
"Live Chat"
YouTube smaller but still clearly readable at 220 x 140. Fullscreen and Live Chat large, bold, elegant modern grotesk sans serif with a disciplined hierarchy and generous leading. The main screen occupies the lower/right half, its translucent chat pane visually distinct and fully inside. Do not combine text with the chat diagram. All text at least 7 percent away from every canvas edge, no cropping, no extra copy, logos, watermark, tagline or labels. Exact spelling Fullscreen as one word, Live Chat with a space, YouTube with capital Y and T.
Image is abstract marketing artwork, not a screenshot, no people, no games, no scenery, no browser window chrome.

Move the two right fullscreen-corner marks from just left of the red chat to the actual FAR RIGHT of the COMPLETE screen, so all four corner brackets surround BOTH the play area and the chat. Add a visible strip of dark video surface around ALL four sides of the chat: shrink its red panel approximately 10 percent so it has a clear inset. Remove the old two right-corner marks and any vertical division seam that makes this look like side-by-side separate panes. The complete video perimeter should be a single16:9 screen; the small red chat overlays its right side. Keep the chat abstract three rows and an input/send symbol, without any text. verification.words: Exact words YouTube, Fullscreen and Live Chat each once; no additional visible text.
verification.composition: Chat overlay visibly inside the fullscreen video boundary.
verification.imageInspection: Actual copied workspace PNG inspected with view_image at native dimensions; matched generated preview, correct words and no cropped letters or unintended scenery.
